# braintrust_ai_secret (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust AI provider secret (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure API keys).

AI secrets are **organization-scoped** — they are available to all projects within the org. For project-scoped credentials, use [`braintrust_env_var`](env_var) with `object_type = "project"` instead.

The `secret` attribute is write-only. Terraform sends it during create/update but the API never returns it. A masked `preview_secret` is available for verification.

**Tip:** Use Terraform variables with `sensitive = true` for the secret value:

```hcl
variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "braintrust_ai_secret" "openai" {
  name   = "OpenAI"
  type   = "openai"
  secret = var.openai_api_key
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the AI secret. Must be unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret value (e.g. API key). Write-only: the API never returns this value.
- `type` (String) The AI provider type (e.g. "openai", "anthropic", "azure", "google").

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of AI secret creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the AI secret (UUID).
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization.
- `preview_secret` (String) A masked preview of the secret value.
- `updated_at` (String) Date of last AI secret update.
